job_title: Analista de Suporte Júnior | Afirmativa para PCD's
summary: Support employees with endpoint, identity and device incidents, maintain asset records and resolve Jira Service Management requests. Configure corporate computers/devices and support secure access.
requirements: Required: practical Windows 10/11, macOS and Microsoft 365 knowledge, communication, collaborative troubleshooting and interest in ITSM and automation. Preferred: prior practical exposure (including personal projects/internships) to IdP/MDM or Zero Trust, AWS Cloud Practitioner, event AV and certifications such as CompTIA A+ or ITIL. Cloud operations are explicitly outside the role scope.
compensation: Not disclosed in the public posting.
